short.text: Montell Owens held Jacksonville's fullback job through the 2013 season, dressing for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and {{2013.playoffs.games:words}} playoff games without a fumble. He is a blocking and special-teams fullback who can handle a small package of carries and flat throws, and his special-teams work and lead blocking are the strongest parts of his game. He brings dependable utility rather than a featured offensive threat, and route running and hands are where he is limited.

transactions.text: Signed a contract extension with Jacksonville covering 2013 to 2015
